title: Entries of a row-restricted matrix
statement: For a real matrix $A$ indexed by $	ext{Fin}(n)$ and a subset $B$ of its indices, the entry in row $i$ and column $j$ of the matrix obtained by retaining only rows indexed by $B$ is $A_{ij}$ when $i\in B$, and $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: A is a real matrix indexed by Fin(n)
B is a finite subset of Fin(n)
i and j are indices in Fin(n)
